fields.label: Buyer
fields.description: Buyer/institution name as the anchor advert carried it

fields.label: Buyer (Normalized)
fields.description: market_context.normalize_buyer key - successor matching is by this + category (section 8: match by buyer + category, never title text)

fields.label: Category
fields.description: eTenders category of the anchor advert

fields.label: Anchor (the advert this prediction grows from)
Anchor OCID
fields.description: The advert this watch predicts a successor for - a watch never confirms on its own anchor

fields.label: Anchor Date
fields.description: stated_duration: the anchor's closing date (prediction = close + stated duration); observed_cycle: the latest advert in the cell

fields.label: Source
fields.description: stated_duration: term parsed from advert/pack text, lateness-corrected per buyer; observed_cycle: median observed advert-to-advert gap for the buyer x category cell

fields.label: Stated Duration (Months)
fields.description: The parsed contract term behind a stated_duration watch; 0 on observed_cycle watches

fields.label: Predicted Date
fields.description: Deterministic point prediction; the window around it is what confirms, the point is what error_days measures against

fields.label: Window End
fields.description: predicted_date + 180 days (asymmetric: buyers extend expiring contracts, so late beats early - research section 8, caveat 2)

fields.label: Status
fields.description: confirmed: a same buyer+category advert landed inside the window; missed: none by window end + 60 days grace. Trust = confirmed / (confirmed + missed) per buyer - counts, no probabilities

fields.label: Confirmed By (OCID)
fields.description: The successor advert that confirmed this prediction

fields.label: Error (Days)
fields.description: Signed confirmed_date - predicted_date; the per-buyer running MEDIAN of these is the lateness correction on future stated-duration predictions
